name: Awesome Low Level Design
summary: Curated resources to learn low level design and object-oriented design and to prepare for LLD interviews.
description: A collection covering OOP fundamentals, class relationships, design principles, design patterns, UML and concurrency, with 33 low level design interview problems grouped easy, medium and hard plus 9 concurrency problems. Also links courses, books and a newsletter.
contains: 33 LLD interview problems: 7 easy, 15 medium, 11 hard
OOP fundamentals, class relationships, design principles, design patterns, UML
concurrency concepts: synchronization primitives, deadlock, thread pool, producer-consumer
creational, structural and behavioral design pattern tables
guides: how to learn LLD and how to answer an LLD interview problem
links to courses, books and a newsletter
